narrative.scene:
A software team wants an agent that can repair a bug, test its patch, and show that the repair actually works.
Across this volume, you will follow that agent through model choices, memory, tools, recovery,
evaluation, and the cost of delivering accepted work.

Choose a project below. The repair agent provides the shared experiments;
the research, operations, and support projects ask how those decisions would change in another setting.
Each lab adds a chapter's challenge to the same story. Its parts follow a familiar rhythm: predict,
change a policy, inspect the consequence, and explain the tradeoff. Finish by downloading your discussion
and evidence. This lab lets you practice before chapter 1.
